text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Get this,
familiar! I found a new friend for
you!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Somehow, I've found myself in front of the
station with Sweep Tosho
on my day off.
About an hour ago...

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Familiar,
I've been looking all over for you!
C'mon, it's time to go
shopping!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
I just found this today. "Introducing the
Magical Doggy, a plushie that
soothes
your soul with its adorable eyes—available
now!"

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
It's a magical doggy! I'm so getting my
hands on one, so hurry it up,
will you?!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Thus, we arrive at the nearest toy shop in
search of this magical
plushie...

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Huh?! What do you mean it's sold out?!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Geez, this is no time to be standing
around! Familiar, to the next shop
we go!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
You're sold out too?! How come?! You
better not be hiding one in the
back!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
None here, either! Urgh, then the search
continues, familiar! We're
going until we
find one!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Unfortunately, no matter which toy shop
we go to, the "Magical
Doggy" plush is
sold out.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Huh? What're you down in the dumps for?!
I definitely want one, so
we're not giving
up this easily!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Anyways, this is all your fault,
familiar! If you kept up with me, I
might've been able
to buy one before they sold out
everywhere!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
...I'm sooo getting my hands on one.
Familiar, where's the next store?!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Sweep being stubborn is nothing new, but
I'm a little curious as to
why she's so
adamant on getting this particular toy.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: I know I want it, and that's that! I need my own Magical Doggy!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
That's right! 'Cause Grandma had one just
like it!

text_block_list.name: Sweep's Grandma's Dog
text_block_list.text: Bark, bark!

text_block_list.name: Young Sweep
text_block_list.text: Sob... Hic. Just go away...

text_block_list.name: Sweep's Grandma
text_block_list.text:
There's no point in saying things you
don't
mean. I placed a spell on
her—she can
read the minds of others.

text_block_list.name: Sweep's Grandma
text_block_list.text:
...What's that? Deep down, Sweepy wants
to apologize to her papa?

text_block_list.name: Young Sweep
text_block_list.text:
Th-that's not what I was thinking at
all! I
mean, there's no way I'd say
sorry to
Papa...

text_block_list.name: Young Sweep
text_block_list.text:
There's no way... But wow,
your magic is so
cool Grandma.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Just like Grandma, I want a doggy that can
read minds! But I can't
keep pets at the
dorm, right?

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
That's why I want a Magical Doggy.
I'll cast
a spell on it...

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
And make it into a mind-reading plushie.
Then I'll be one step closer
to becoming a
great witch like Grandma!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Sweep Tosho wants the plushie because it
makes her feel closer to
her grandmother.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
But it's gotten dark out already. Sweep
might be tired from running
around all
day.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Didn't I just say no to that!
Why don't you
get it? If you wanna go
home that much,
just go by yourself!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: ...Huh?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The next morning, I spot Sweep as I wait
by the academy gate and
call out to her.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: What, you feel like apologizing now?

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Yesterday, I bet you looked for only a
little bit. You probably
couldn't find it!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: What? What do you m—huh?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I hand over the promised present to a
speechless Sweep Tosho.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: A Magical Doggy! You really found one?!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
But, it was sold out everywhere! I totally
thought it was a lost cause...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The Magical Doggy plushie is really
popular, so I had to call a toy
store in the
neighboring prefecture to snag one.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
You mean you really kept looking after
you sent me home?!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: For me... to become a witch...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Saying it would help her become a witch
was a bit of a stretch, but I
also believed it
would give her the push she needed to
keep chasing her dreams.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
...Wh-what am I gonna do with you? Fine
then, I'll be your new
master!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Well... Y'know? It's only natural for a
familiar to work for their master,
right?

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Even if my familiar didn't find it,
I probably
would've found it myself,
right?

text_block_list.name: Teacher A
text_block_list.text:
Your trainer helped you, right? Make sure
to say thank you later,
okay?

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Hmph,
I don't care! It's not like I asked for
help. My familiar did it all
on their own!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
I really found myself a weird familiar...
Doggy, you think so too, don't
you?

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: ...What's that face for?

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: You're wrong! I'm not grateful to them at all, and you're so off the mark!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
That's enough—you gotta learn how to
read minds better, you hear
me?!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Despite her grumbling, Sweep Tosho hugs
her Magical Doggy tightly
and crawls
under the covers.
